statement: KinConfBench evaluates 2,225 high-quality human kinase chains and reports roughly 60–80% conformational-state classification accuracy across four cofolding models, weak association between ligand-pose geometric success and correct kinase state, severe repeated-sampling mode collapse, negligible induced-fit diversity, and prevalent apo drift that worsens on post-cutoff complexes.
locator: Abstract and Introduction; npj Drug Discovery 3, 33 (2026)
notes: Direct evidence that ligand RMSD and ligand-conditioned receptor-state correctness are different tasks.
